note: Resolved dedupe-gate hits. resolution is reuse, split, or distinct. Add a pair only after choosing one of those. Do not add a pair to hide a real duplicate. The gate reads this file.

pairs.reason: kalman is the linear estimator. extended-kalman-filter linearizes a nonlinear measurement and lives in the optimization box. The shared words are the name of the linear skill, not a second copy of it.

convex-functions is the definition of a convex objective. convex-optimality-global is the later fact that a stationary point of a convex objective is global. One is a prerequisite of the other, not a duplicate.
least-squares-data-fitting is linear fitting of measurements. circle-fitting-least-squares is the nonlinear algebraic fit of a circle. Same least-squares idea, different skill.
Forward mode pushes a tangent. Reverse mode pulls an adjoint. They are the two modes of automatic differentiation, taught as separate skills.

convexity-first-order is the chord and gradient test for a convex function. first-order-optimality is the stationarity condition for a minimizer. The shared words name the derivative order, not the same skill.
